pages.title: Dyson Shell Segment
pages.text: A curved plate of a shell intended to surround a star completely, capturing all of its output. Stellar iron forms its structure, metamaterial catches the light, and a Higgs field capacitor keeps the mass low enough for the shell to hold itself together. It is warm on its inner face and cold on the outer.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)A solid shell collapses under its own weight. In the Metamaterial Weaver, with Stellar Plasma, I added a Higgs Field Capacitor to each segment, reducing the mass so the shell could finally hold.
